summary: Logistics CRM (Russian) full-stack tested. Backend: 9/9 pytest passed (root, seed idempotent, dashboard aggregation, CRUD for clients/carriers/orders/leads, 404 handling). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): Dashboard renders KPIs (1 063 000 ₽ revenue, margin, status bars, top clients), all 5 tabs navigate (Дашборд/Заявки/Клиенты/Перевозчики/Обзвон), lists populate with seeded data, '+' FAB on Orders opens create modal, submitted TEST-UI-001 order and verified it appears in list. No red screens, no console errors (only deprecated pointerEvents warning).

issues: Console warning: props.pointerEvents deprecated — use style.pointerEvents (cosmetic, RN web)

action_items: Optional: replace props.pointerEvents with style.pointerEvents to silence RN web deprecation warnings.

Optional: package version mismatches reported by Expo (@react-native-async-storage/async-storage 3.0.2 vs expected 2.2.0; expo-linear-gradient 55.0.13 vs expected ~15.0.8) — not breaking but worth aligning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py auto_seed only triggers if orders==0 — clients/carriers/leads emptiness not checked; minor but acceptable.
PUT /clients and /carriers replace via ClientCreate/CarrierCreate (full overwrite, not partial) — by design, fine for now.
All endpoints async, _id excluded everywhere, env vars used, Pydantic validation in place, CORS open. Solid baseline.
seed_data_creation: No additional seed; auto-seeded sample (5 clients, 5 carriers, 7 orders, 7 leads) was used. Test artifacts (TEST_*) are deleted by their tests; one TEST-UI-001 order remains from the UI create test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_crm_api.py — reusable. Frontend testIDs in place: dashboard-screen, orders-list, clients-list, carriers-list, leads-list, add-order-btn, order-card-{idx}, new-order-number, new-from, new-to, create-order-submit. Mobile viewport 390x844. EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL points to https://crm-design-preview.preview.emergentagent.com.
